intro: Sourced from the pristine Himalayas, this authentic Shilajit resin is rich in Fulvic Acid and over 80 essential minerals that help restore energy, improve stamina, and promote overall vitality. A natural rejuvenator for mind and body.

li: Take a pea-sized amount of resin.
Dissolve in warm water or milk.
Consume on an empty stomach in the morning.
Suggested dosage: 1–2 times daily or as directed by physician.
